arms.cross: grasp part of the object's source + place part of the receptacle's source
arms.mismatch: the grasp part of a DIFFERENT-shape object's source applied to the target's object
arms.prior: the zero-shot prior on the same init states (m3_final zeroshot for 5 and 36; p3_final zeroshot for 49 and 59)

metrics.executor: experiments/p3_compose_sim.py --phases object_carry as committed in 12a75c8 (object-state phases; approach in the object's frame; object-centric carry relative to the receptacle, or the world for fixtures; release phase); no policy

hypotheses.Z1: PRIMARY: cross > the zero-shot prior over the 80 paired placements (exact two-sided sign test p < 0.05) and the pooled cross rate >= 0.5
hypotheses.Z2: cross > mismatch over the 80 paired placements: exact two-sided sign test p < 0.05 and a difference >= 0.15
hypotheses.reading: Z1 and Z2: a task the prior fails is executed by composing object-relative bindings drawn from other tasks, including the prior's own successes -- composition transfers skills across tasks and scenes; Z1 only: transfer without object specificity; neither: the exploratory P3a'' result does not replicate

metrics.placements: init states 30-49 of each target (80 in all)
metrics.plan: docs/PLAN_TRANSFER.md P3 (cross-task binding transfer), CONFIRMATORY on targets untouched by P3a/P3a'/P3a''
metrics.sources: the first successful episode in trial order among the recorded practice (m5_practice, m6_round1, m6_round2) and the PRIOR's recorded zero-shot rollouts on solved tasks (p3_seed: states 0-9), all replayed bit-exactly with object state (p0_replay)
metrics.unavailable: if a source task has no success among its recordings, that target is reported as not composable and excluded from the pooled reads
metrics.written_before: any P3b composition run (the p3_seed recordings and the p3_final zero-shot controls are running; neither depends on the executor)
